title: AutoFix Ticket Context (via n8n)
description: Stage 6B: the sanitized Jira ticket context returned by n8n Workflow 05 ("Get AutoFix Ticket Context"), after validate-ticket-response.sh has independently re-checked it. This -- not any PostgreSQL snapshot, and not a direct Jira REST call -- is what build-agent-prompt.sh renders into the Copilot CLI prompt. The Agent Runner never talks to Jira directly; n8n holds the only Jira credential in the whole system.

source.description: Provenance marker -- confirms this context was fetched through n8n's Jira credential, never directly by the Agent Runner.

key.description: Jira issue key, e.g. AUTO-7. Must equal ^AUTO-[0-9]+$.

status.description: Must not be one of the closed statuses (Done/Closed/Cancelled).

labels.description: Must include auto-generated, autofix-candidate, and an autofix-fp-<sha256> fingerprint label.

incidentId.description: Must equal the incidentId of the claimed job.

fingerprint.description: Must equal the fingerprint of the claimed job and the autofix-fp-<sha256> label suffix.

stackTrace.description: Truncated to 12000 characters by n8n. Must be non-empty.

approvedAgentContext.description: Text of comments marked [AUTOFIX_AGENT_CONTEXT] only, marker stripped, each truncated to 2000 characters and the whole array truncated to a 6000-character total by n8n. Unmarked comments are never included.

contextHash.description: SHA-256 digest computed by n8n over the normalized fields, for audit/provenance -- not a secret.
